subject: Leitner Energy GmbH

classification.tariffModel: host-configured CPO wholesale tariff plus EMSP retail conditions

positiveEvidence: Leitner Energy first-party Green Mobility Cars page states that the charging-station owner defines the EUR/kWh tariff.
The same first-party page states that the driver's price depends on the conditions agreed with the driver's EMSP, while the CPO price is defined by the CPO/owner relationship.
negativeFindings: No deterministic current network-wide public direct/ad-hoc retail tariff was established.
A single Leitner-wide EUR/kWh value must not be inferred or extrapolated.
deduplicationPolicy: Do not assign an unreconciled current PUN partyId to Leitner from name similarity alone.
resumeCondition: Obtain a current Leitner EVSE/address or partyId, then map it deterministically to its owner-configured tariff/direct payment surface; alternatively accept a new first-party publication proving a network/class-wide direct retail grid.
antiRepeat: Do not repeat generic Leitner tariff searches without new evidence; proceed through EVSE/partyId identity and station payment surface.

canonicalImpact.reason: Current deterministic PUN partyId identity not yet proven.
